items.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee posted on X late Friday night (Oct 16) that he had just reached London and urged supporters to gather at the Mahatma Gandhi statue in Parliament Square at noon on Saturday, Oct 17: 'It's time the world sees the reality of vote chor and murderer of democracy... International danka bajane ka time aa gaya hai.' First international-stage escalation of the anti-SIR/CJP-linked agitation; Rathee was detained from his Gurugram home on Oct 10 and released Oct 11 after ~18 hours.
items.title: Dhruv Rathee calls for protest at London's Parliament Square against 'vote chori'

items.summary: A DMK parliamentary party meeting at Anna Arivalayam (Chennai) today, chaired by M.K. Stalin, adopted a resolution demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal: 'He must be removed and subjected to an appropriate inquiry' (for SIR voter deletions overriding fellow ECs' objections). Demanded a return to paper ballots (EVM/VVPAT discrepancies), a representation to the President seeking complete SIR cancellation before the Assembly elections, and future polls on existing rolls. Backed CJP/student-group protests as 'a greater impact than those organised by the Congress' (dig at Congress). DMK MP Kanimozhi said 'We have already supported CJP'; she attended the Oct-16 Chennai Rajarathinam Stadium student-group protest demanding Kumar's resignation.
items.title: DMK MPs meet (chaired by Stalin) demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal, return to paper ballots
